description: This file defines the ReturnAction controller class for the Opencart admin interface, handling CRUD operations (list, form, save, delete) for return actions in the localisation module.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for managing return actions within the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry; loads the list view of return actions with necessary breadcrumbs and page setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct calls to load the list of return actions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates HTML for listing return actions, including pagination and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays form for creating or editing a return action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for saving a new or existing return action, with validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions, with permission and dependency checks.
